title: Claude Fable 5 joins the model lineup
summary:
Claude Fable 5 was added, Wikimind joined the app catalog, and the README caught up with recent API changes.

Added paid-only `claude-fable-5` with text and image input, tool support, a 1M-token context, and support for up to 20 reference images.

Added the French-language learning app Wikimind to the catalog and featured lists. A separate daily update refreshed app metrics and health-check records; it did not change the apps themselves.

The README now documents June 10 changes to content-moderation error responses and the removal of three legacy image parameters from the API and SDKs.

daily.title: Claude Fable 5 added
daily.text: Use `claude-fable-5` for text and image input, with tools, a 1M-token context, and up to 20 reference images. It is a paid-only model. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=claude-fable-5).
